name: ossuary-dual-frame-ornate-silver
notes: The divider is intentionally independent from the outer frame so skull and finial ornaments never stretch.
Use the normalized content wells when the complete master is scaled as one fixed-ratio asset.
For variable-width layouts, assemble the exported outer and divider slices instead of stretching the complete master.
The generated RGB source is retained for provenance; use one of the RGBA master files in production.
